senses.gloss: ch. c. (b. h. בְּעִיר; בער; cmp. also בָּעָה) grazing animal, cattle.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 1:24">Targ. Gen. I, 24</cite> sq.; a. fr.—
Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ bot.; Lev. R. s. 27, a. e. ב׳ דקיקא small cattle; v. בְּהֵמָה.—Pesik. B’shall. p. 93ᵃ אתקן לי ב׳ get an animal ready for me (for travel).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 105a:8">Snh. 105ᵃ</cite> (in Hebr. dict., play on <cite ref="B01030"><he>בְּעוֹר</he></cite>).
